【Abstract · abstract-1-2】Single-cell RNA sequencing can reveal RNA abundance with high quantitative accuracy, sensitivity and throughput1.

【Abstract · abstract-1-6】We validate its accuracy in the neural crest lineage, demonstrate its use on multiple published datasets and technical platforms, reveal the branching lineage tree of the developing mouse hippocampus, and examine the kinetics of transcription in human embryonic brain.

evidence.text: Single-cell RNA sequencing can reveal RNA abundance with high quantitative accuracy, sensitivity and throughput1.

We validate its accuracy in the neural crest lineage, demonstrate its use on multiple published datasets and technical platforms, reveal the branching lineage tree of the developing mouse hippocampus, and examine the kinetics of transcription in human embryonic brain.
